title: Eighteen typed words of a composable refinement diagram
statement: Let $B$ be a scheme, $f:X\to Y$ a morphism of schemes over $B$, $c_i=(j_i,p_i)$ for $i=0,1,2$ compactifications of its underlying morphism, and $r:c_0\to c_1$, $s:c_1\to c_2$ refinements [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Assume all three $j_i$ are quasi-compact. Use the typed finite expressions [def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain] and the over-$B$ ambient, open and proper maps attached to compactifications [def-sf-integral-system-realization-data]. Define a function from $\{0,\ldots,17\}$ to pairs consisting of an output scheme over $B$ and an expression with one variable $x$ on $X$. In order its entries are $x$; $J_0x,J_1x,J_2x$; $S_rJ_0x,S_sJ_1x,S_sS_rJ_0x,S_{sr}J_0x$; $S_{p_0}J_0x,S_{p_1}J_1x,S_{p_2}J_2x$; $S_{p_1}S_rJ_0x,S_{p_2}S_sJ_1x,S_{p_2}S_sS_rJ_0x,S_{p_2}S_{sr}J_0x$; and the three chosen-compactification compact-support expressions for $(f,c_0),(f,c_1),(f,c_2)$ applied to $x$. Every output is the actual target of that expression, and each proper refinement is viewed over $B$ through its map to $Y$. Identity diagrams are obtained by constant $c_i$ and identity refinements. This defines only the finite word list, without an admissibility or bound assertion.

  | ⟨0, _⟩ => ⟨X, .var ⟨()⟩⟩
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => ⟨compactAmbient (c 0),
